method: On every valid simple closed centerline source ring whose v1 Polygon.buffer(-15,quad_segs=16) has positive area, repeat the interior buffer on final6decimal source coordinates. Negative15 models the inner edge of a constant Regular30 round pen. No fullfont build or raster pass.
scope: Explicitly closed paths only. Excludes invalid/nonsimple centerline rings, loops formed by open paths or multiple paths, same-path open self-overlaps, and every other weight. Positive remaining area checks counter survival, not a guarantee of acceptable raster legibility.
scope_note: Historical v1.1.0 evidence before geometric simplification. Current sources inherit its optical frames; current geometry and validation are recorded in geometric-simplification.json.
